endorsements.name: Erlend Leiknes
endorsements.label: CVE-2019-17632
endorsements.description: In Eclipse Jetty versions 9.4.21.v20190926, 9.4.22.v20191022, and 9.4.23.v20191118, the generation of default unhandled Error response content (in text/html and text/json Content-Type) does not escape Exception messages in stacktraces included in error output.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.

endorsements.name: Erlend Leiknes
endorsements.label: So Long, and Thanks for All the Phish
endorsements.description: A rare look behind the scenes of a global phishing-as-a-service operation. We tell the story of how we infiltrated a phishing group, cracked their software, exploited a hidden backdoor, and followed an OSINT rabbit hole to uncover the identify of the primary software developer.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 33
